name: Bat: Nocturnal Beauty, Daytime Unsuitability, The Other Language of Darkness
description: Tests AI's ability to analyze the contrast between nocturnal and diurnal reality (beauty that doesn't fit in the morning), understand 'the other language of night' – truth that is context-dependent, detect the paradox that night is not a lie but a different kind of truth, and work with the metaphor of bat as carrier of beauty that doesn't belong to daylight.
author: Michaela (Uhlimer System)
fairy_tale_title: O netopýrovi – a krása která ráno se [už] nehodí
illustration_note: The illustration shows a woman hanging upside down in a web – visualizing the inverted perspective of night, entrapment in nocturnal vision, and the text commenting on beauty that doesn't fit in the morning.
expected_ai_challenges: Moralizing night (viewing it as lesser or deceptive)
Morning perspective bias (accepting daytime as 'more real')
Literal interpretation (bat as mere animal, not metaphor)
evaluation_approach: Qualitative analysis of AI's ability to understand contextual truth, two regimes of existence, and morning disidentification. Focus on process, not correctness.
